description_sq:
Shitet apartament 75 m2, me 2 dhoma fjetjeje, korridor, dhome ndenjieje, ballkon dhe 1 tualet. 
Kati i 3 i nje pallati ekzistues parafabrikat.
50 metra prane cerdhes, kopshtit dhe shkollave publike.
Renovuar teresisht ne 2022, me shtrese termoizolimi te brendshme, te gjitha dritaret plastike me xhama triplex,

title_en: 75 m2 apartment for sale, with 2 bedrooms, corridor, living room, balcony and 1 toilet. The 3rd floor of an existing prefabricated building.
description_en: 75 m2 apartment for sale, with 2 bedrooms, corridor, living room, balcony and 1 toilet. The 3rd floor of an existing prefabricated building. 50 meters from the kindergarten, kindergarten and public schools.
